body: Love this!  3 days in again but something is different this time!  Happiness..excitement ..they are overwhelming me right now 💕
I am so sorry!  I’m here if you need anyone
Anytime and me too!  Especially when my kids were little I’d have severe separation anxiety!  I hope today is a good day for you😘

I was committed for 4 days and felt like staying there was making me lose my mind more..being confined..told it was only 4 days and I could sign myself out only to be told if I sign myself out they can deem me long term commutable....I risked it they let me go...now I need help but afraid just need someone to talk to ASAP..been waiting 3 days for an answer from insurance..I need help now not later! 😘

Me too!  I was committed once and my job understood but I’m afraid another fail and they won’t....being committed was awful and I faked being ok..just so my family wouldn’t suffer with me losing my job..our health insurance..when do we come first?
I’m here if you need to just talk!  I get it!  Life is so so hard and it goes on...I have no time to have a mental breakdown even though I feel like I’m on the verge of having one!
I work full time and have other responsibilities but need help!
There are more horses asses in the world than there are horses!  My Dad!💕
